title: achillea millefolium subsp. pallidotegula
intro: Achillea millefolium subsp. pallidotegula, commonly known as a subspecies of the Yarrow plant, is a flowering plant species in the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Achillea millefolium subsp. pallidotegula include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which have been reported to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and relieve menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids such as apigenin, luteolin, and thymol, among others.
